player_intent: Every real pistol appears at human scale, keeps both hands at authored pistol contacts, and fires toward the reticle from a stable square-shouldered two-hand ready pose while directional movement stays centered beneath it.
acceptance_rule: Equipping any pistol through res://main.tscn consumes its saved visual contract and TWO_HAND_PISTOL animation family. An accepted standing shot resolves to pistol_idle and an accepted crouched shot resolves to pistol_idle_kneeling. FIRE_RECOVERY remains active for 1.2 seconds without a separate fire OneShot. During idle, W+A, W+D, S+A, and S+D recovery, frames 1, 2, 4, 8, 12, and 18 must keep the physical bore within 1 degree of camera-owned reticle aim, optic-up roll within 6 degrees, both palms within 1 cm of their physical contacts, shoulders within 10 degrees of square and 4 cm of level, and elbows between 38 and 155 degrees. Forward visual input is positive Y. These angle budgets do not certify natural arm symmetry or entry continuity. The trigger socket and barrel base must stay within 20 percent of shoulder width of the aim plane, with left crossing limited to 10 percent. The pistol-only trigger-palm target, elbow guidance, and rigid root correction must converge to the authored pose as existing readiness fades; at terminal ready-to-zero and the following four frames, each static standing/crouched palm step must stay below 1 cm. The same saved mount must preserve world scale, physical trigger-to-support socket distance, and barrel-base-to-muzzle length across base, firing, and recovery. A unit palm basis must not apply the inverse-scaled BoneAttachment mount directly in world space. Continuous IK, generic two-arm rifle IK, new weapon owners, socket recalibration to mask errors, and gameplay authority changes remain forbidden.

visual_check: In res://main.tscn, equip Mark 23 and F57. Fire while idle and on all forward/back diagonals in standing/crouched posture. Observe the real-size pistol, both palms, elbow symmetry, and entry motion; numerical bore/contact checks alone do not establish a natural pose. After the 1.2-second recovery, observe the complete readiness fade and its last frame: neither arm nor pistol size may pop when parenting returns to the authored mount. Reload separately to verify action ownership.
known_limitations: The moving-pistol accepted-callback mask publication fixes measured canonical Mark 23 A and WA first-shot bore error without an extra tree evaluation or changing source playheads. The legacy frozen crouch-diagonal fixture at 5.45 m/s still fails its unchanged 155-degree elbow limit; true canonical crouch movement, first-shot frames, and full eight-pistol coverage must remain separate proofs. This bounded timing fix does not certify all directional arm shapes.

The September 4 Blender high-ready candidate passes ten offset-aim Mark 23 stance/direction cases in memory, but is not assigned to the saved profile. LOW-only immutable-track preservation now passes all eight neutral/offset stance equip/return centering and physical contact checks. A newly covered neutral crouched fire case fails: 35.90 degrees required correction exceeds the saved 32-degree limit, leaving 3.69 degrees bore error. Do not promote the candidate pair or claim all-pistol success. See tools/pistol_low_ready_contact_regression.gd and docs/ANIMATION_AUDIT_20260904.md. The browser ZIP has not been rebuilt.
Immediate pistol ready-weight entry still causes measured pre-shot-to-fire pose jumps; this recovery-exit change does not redesign entry blending.

The existing authored standing firing pose has asymmetric elbows. At corrected full weapon size, Mark 23 standing support contact measured approximately 12 mm and fails the 10 mm acceptance budget; the previous inverse-64-size pistol concealed that error.
Full-family directional and rendered naturalness checks remain necessary before claiming all pistol animations are fixed.
